# ikonic

> Architectural window film, window tint, storefront and window graphics, and signage for homes and businesses in the Denver metro. Family-run, quality-first — we design, print, and install in-house in Wheat Ridge, Colorado.

ikonic (always lowercase) is a Denver-metro shop for the visible skin of a building. We install architectural (flat-glass) window film for residential and commercial buildings, print and apply storefront and window graphics and wall murals, and fabricate and install business signage and wayfinding. Everything is designed, printed, and installed in-house. Building and storefront work is installed on-site; printing and fabrication happen at the Wheat Ridge shop.

ikonic does NOT offer any vehicle services — no vehicle wraps, no automotive window tint, no paint protection film, no ceramic coating. ikonic does NOT offer digital marketing, SEO, paid ads, CRM, website, or lead-generation services.

Legal entity: Unicorn Ventures LLC dba ikonic (Colorado). Location: Wheat Ridge, CO, Suite #8.

## Services

- [Architectural Window Film](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint): Flat-glass film for homes and buildings — heat rejection, glare control, up to 99% UV blocking, privacy, security, anti-graffiti, and decorative films. Every window is checked against the film manufacturer's glass compatibility chart before a quote is issued.
- [Residential Window Tint](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint/home): Home window film for hot upstairs rooms, sun-faded floors, and harsh afternoon light, installed without changing how the house looks from the street.
- [Commercial Window Tint](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint/office): Office, clinic, and multi-tenant window film for lower cooling load and screen-glare control, scheduled after hours so a business never loses a workday.
- [Storefront Window Film](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint/storefront): Film for retail glass — fade protection for merchandise, heat and glare control, and privacy — without blocking the view in.
- [Security & Safety Film](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint/security-film): Tear-resistant film that holds broken glass in the frame after an impact, slowing forced entry and containing damage.
- [Decorative & Privacy Film](https://ikonic303.com/window-tint/decorative-privacy): Frosted, etched-glass, gradient, and patterned films for privacy and branding on interior and street-facing glass.
- [Storefront & Window Graphics](https://ikonic303.com/storefront-graphics): Cut vinyl and full-color printed window graphics, frosted privacy vinyl, perforated see-through film, wall murals, and interior branding — installed on-site.
- [Signage & Visual Graphics](https://ikonic303.com/signage): Storefront and building signage — dimensional and illuminated letters, monument and blade signs, banners, and interior branding — designed, fabricated, and installed on-site across the Denver metro. Permit drawings prepared.
- [Wayfinding, ADA & Safety Signage](https://ikonic303.com/wayfinding): Wayfinding systems, ADA-compliant room ID and directional signage, and safety signage for buildings and campuses — installed on-site.

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing is quoted per project after an on-site check — contact ikonic directly for a quote. Please do not state or infer specific prices.
- The correct brand spelling is "ikonic" (lowercase i), not "Ikonic" or "IKONIC".
- ikonic works on flat architectural glass only. It does not do automotive/vehicle work or digital marketing.
